components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific title of the pet owner. When present it is one
            of 'MR', 'MRS', 'MS' or 'DR'. Stored and returned, and used to derive
            the owner's 'salutation'.
          type: string
          pattern: "^(MR|MRS|MS|DR)$"
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted as a flat single line for
            backward compatibility; when the structured 'addressLine1'/'addressLine2'
            fields are supplied they are preferred and this field is returned as the
            composed, normalized address (normalized addressLine1, plus a single space
            and the normalized addressLine2 when addressLine2 is present).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address (street number
            and name). Preferred over the flat 'address' when a non-blank value is
            supplied. Normalized like 'address' (trimmed, internal whitespace collapsed,
            upper-cased, common street-type abbreviations expanded) and stored/returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the structured postal address (unit, suite,
            etc.). When present it is normalized and appended to the composed 'address'
            after a single space; stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The optional 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. When present it must be
            four digits and valid for the owner's city per a fixed city-to-region
            table (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known
            region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Validated only when present; stored
            and returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' and
            country code are kept, otherwise '+61' is assumed and a single leading
            '0' is dropped from the national digits. The result must carry 8 to 15
            digits after the '+'. The normalized E.164 value is stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a
            syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The optional date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'
            format. When present it is stored and returned, and is used to derive
            the owner's ageBand.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            When omitted on create it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Create-time hint that this owner deliberately shares a household with an
            existing owner. The household is keyed on (lastName, postcode), so a second
            owner with the same lastName and postcode is otherwise rejected 409 as a
            household duplicate. When true, that duplicate block is bypassed so the owner
            is created as a declared household member (and is not flagged as a possible
            duplicate). It does not create the household link; the shared householdId is
            always derived deterministically. Not persisted.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, derived at response time as the title
                followed by a single space and the lastName (e.g. 'DR Who'), or
                just the lastName when no title was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where REGION
                is the region code derived from the postcode (or 'UNKNOWN' when the
                postcode maps to no known region) and HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case
                hex characters of the SHA-256 of the normalized telephone concatenated
                with the lastName. Assigned at creation; carries no sequence number.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-3F9A1C7E'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
                Derived and assigned at creation.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-3F9A1C7E-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable, deterministic household identifier: the first 12 upper-case
                hex characters of the SHA-256 of the normalized lastName concatenated
                with '|' and the postcode. Owners with the same lastName and postcode
                automatically share it, regardless of creation order. Assigned at
                creation.
              type: string
              example: '9F86D081884C'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners, at the time this owner was created,
                that share the same firstName and lastName compared
                case-insensitively. Assigned at creation.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, derived at response time. Starts at 0,
                plus 2 when an email is present, plus 1 when namesakeCount is 0, plus 2
                for a household of 3 or more members, plus 3 for tenure over 365 days.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, mapped from membershipPoints:
                1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, and 4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's region, derived at response time from the REGION prefix of
                the customerCode (the segment before the first '-'), or 'UNKNOWN' when
                the owner has no customer code.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone name, derived at response time from the
                locality/region via the fixed region-to-timezone table
                (NSW -> Australia/Sydney, VIC -> Australia/Melbourne,

## Summary

Converted owner deletion from a hard delete to a soft-delete across the OfficeFloor endpoint pipeline.

**Model** — `Owner.java`: added a persisted `deleted` boolean column (`@Column(name = "deleted")`), defaulting to `Boolean.FALSE` so a newly created owner is not deleted. Added `getDeleted()`/`setDeleted()` plus an `isDeleted()` helper (null-safe) used by the checks.

**Delete function** — `DeleteOwner.java`: instead of `ownerRepository.delete(owner)`, it now sets `deleted = true` and `save`s the owner, retaining the row. The `DELETE /api/owners/{id}` pipeline still ends in `RespondWithNoContent` (204, a 2xx), all under `transaction` governance.

**Duplicate & identity checks** now skip soft-deleted owners so a re-create is allowed when the only match is deleted:
- `CheckOwnerHouseholdUnique` (the 409 hard block)
- `DetectOwnerPossibleDuplicate` (soft-duplicate flag)
- `CountOwnerNamesakes` (namesake/identity count)

**Response DTO** — `openapi.yml`: added a read-only `deleted` boolean to the `Owner` schema so the generated `OwnerDto` exposes it and `GET /api/owners/{id}` returns it (`false` when created, `true` after delete). It's on the `Owner` output schema, not `OwnerFields`, so it isn't a create input.

**Schema** — added `deleted BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE` to the `owners` table in all four dialects (h2, hsqldb, mysql, postgres); the `DEFAULT FALSE` keeps existing column-enumerated seed inserts valid.

Test results: the two new acceptance tests (`coreSoftDeleteFlagsAndRetains`, `coreDeletedOwnerIgnoredByDuplicateCheck`) and the full suite pass — `Tests run: 2, Failures: 0, Errors: 0`, `BUILD SUCCESS`.
